name: NIQE Quality Score
description: Computes Natural Image Quality Evaluator blind quality score — AI images often score differently from natural photos (Mittal et al., 2013).
mechanism:
이 방법은 implements the Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) by Mittal et al. (2013) for blind quality assessment:

1. **NSSFeature추출**: The image is decomposed into normalized luminance coefficients using mean-subtracted contrast-normalized (MSCN) coefficients: Î(x,y) = (I(x,y) − μ(x,y))/(σ(x,y) + C). These MSCN coefficients of natural images follow a unit Gaussian distribution.

2. **GeneralizedGaussian분포(GGD)Fitting**: MSCN coefficient distributions are fit to a GGD parameterized by shape (α) and variance (σ²). Additionally, pairwise products of adjacent MSCN coefficients are modeled using an asymmetric GGD (AGGD) in four directions (horizontal, vertical, and two diagonals).

3. **MultivariateGaussian(MVG)Model**: The extracted NSS features (GGD shape, variance, AGGD parameters) form a feature vector. A pristine MVG model (μₙ, Σₙ) is pre-computed from a corpus of natural undistorted images.

4. **QualityDistance계산**: The NIQE score is computed as the Mahalanobis-like distance: D = √((μ₁−μ₂)ᵀ((Σ₁+Σ₂)/2)⁻¹(μ₁−μ₂)) between the test image's feature distribution (μ₁, Σ₁) and the pristine model (μ₂, Σ₂). Lower scores indicate more natural-looking images.

5. **ForensicApplication**: AI 생성 images often deviate from natural scene statistics (NSS) captured by NIQE. While visually plausible, synthetic images exhibit subtle violations of NSS regularity — particularly in local contrast normalization and adjacent coefficient dependencies — yielding elevated NIQE scores that serve as a generation indicator.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
